mapper.select: select uac.dates, 'ods_user_account_record' `source`, uac.id `source_id`, uac.user_id, (case uac.is_add when 0 then 0 - uac.amount when 1 then uac.amount end) amount, uac.source `record_type`, (case uac.source when 1 then 'game' when 2 then 'withdraw' when 3 then 'withdraw return' when 4 then 'first_amount' when 5 then uac.source_id end) `operation`, gc.game_name, uv.max_pvn version, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, u.dates register_dates, u.create_time register_date, uv.pvn register_version, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.create_time, uac.create_time) register_cohort_day, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, u.dates, uac.dates) register_day, uac.create_time from ods_user_account_record uac INNER JOIN ods_user u on (uac.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT uv.user_id, MIN(uv.pvn) pvn, max(uv.pvn) max_pvn FROM ods_user_version uv where uv.dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uv on (uv.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (u.aid = uh.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN ods_ab_game_config gc on (gc.id = uac.source_id) where uac.dates = #{dates} limit #{rows} OFFSET #{startRows}
